kutipan: An early start, a cold trail, and a morning on Andong together.

items.caption: Basecamp Pendem, Magelang. A cold start before sunrise.
items.alt: Early morning atmosphere at Basecamp Pendem, Mount Andong

kutipan: Still catching our breath. A good place to stop.

items.caption: Stopping for a moment on the ridge, eating a lollipop before the long climb.
items.alt: Posing in a pink jacket while holding a lollipop against the green ridge trail of Mount Andong

items.caption: Tidying wind-blown hair while looking at Merbabu and Merapi across the valley.
items.alt: Back view in a pink jacket facing the silhouettes of Mount Merbabu and Merapi over a green valley

items.caption: Smiling back to make sure we're still walking side by side along the green ridge.
items.alt: Looking back with a warm smile and a backpack on, with the Mount Andong savanna trail in the background

items.caption: The exhaustion of climbing vanished the moment we managed to strike a silly pose together by the trail.
items.alt: Selfie of two people making funny faces and sticking out their tongues while holding a lollipop by the trailside

items.caption: A narrow path cutting through the green ridge of Mount Andong, already busy with morning hikers.
items.alt: View of the narrow green ridge trail of Mount Andong with a line of hikers and a summit direction sign

items.caption: Pausing briefly on the dirt and stone steps, looking back while still holding the lollipop.
items.alt: Looking at the camera on the rocky savanna trail of Mount Andong while biting a lollipop stick, with a morning valley backdrop

items.caption: Standing on the edge of the savanna with Mount Merbabu and a thin wisp of Merapi's peak in the distance.
items.alt: Side view in a pink jacket holding a lollipop against the silhouettes of Mount Merbabu and Merapi

items.judul: Looking at the Summit from Behind
items.caption: Taking in the patchwork of rice fields in the valley below, framed by the calm silhouettes of Merbabu and Merapi.
items.alt: Close side view from behind a shoulder looking at the silhouettes of Mount Merbabu and Merapi over a valley of rice fields

items.judul: Savanna Clip: Smile in Front of Merbabu
items.caption: A short recording on the savanna ridge as the camera slowly pulls back to reveal the grandeur of Merbabu and Merapi.
items.alt: Short video of smiling while holding a lollipop on the Mount Andong savanna with Mount Merbabu and Merapi in the background

items.caption: The most candid moment — busy posing thinking it's a photo, while being secretly recorded on video.
items.alt: Candid video of posing playfully in front of the camera while thinking it's a photo on the Mount Andong savanna

kutipan: No photos here. We were too busy getting up the hill.
narasi: It was steeper than it looked.
Just footsteps on gravel and a few stops to catch our breath.

kutipan: We made it. Time to sit down and take in the view.

items.caption: Finally reaching the Alap-Alap summit marker. A relieved smile holding the summit sign after conquering all the climbs.
items.alt: Photo of two people flanking the green Alap-Alap summit marker on Mount Andong while holding the MT Andong wooden sign

items.caption: Standing side by side under the Sunrise Camp sign after hiking via Pendem, with the grandeur of Merbabu and Merapi as our witness behind us.
items.alt: Photo of two people under the wooden Sunrise Camp 1704 Mdpl sign on Mount Andong with Mount Merbabu in the background

items.caption: Meeting the fluffiest resident on the peak, stopping for a moment to pet its head.
items.alt: Crouching to pet a soft grey mountain cat at the summit of Mount Andong

items.judul: Morning Light at the Camp Area
items.caption: A warm smile bathed in morning sunlight among the tents of waking hikers.
items.alt: Morning selfie bathed in golden sunlight among the tents at the summit of Mount Andong

items.caption: The cutest moment at the summit: striking matching claw and pout poses while enjoying the warm blue morning sky.
items.alt: Cheerful selfie of two people making claw and pout poses under a bright blue sky at the summit of Mount Andong

items.judul: Summit Clip: Laughter in the Morning Wind
items.caption: Hands in jacket pockets to keep warm, hair blown by the summit wind, and small laughter that warmed the atmosphere.
items.alt: Candid video of smiling and laughing in the morning summit wind of Mount Andong

items.caption: Extra slot ready for the next summit photo collection.
items.alt: Placeholder for the seventh summit memory photo

items.caption: Extra slot ready for the next summit photo collection.
items.alt: Placeholder for the eighth summit memory photo

kutipan: We hoped for a sea of clouds. We got a clear blue sky, and it was enough.

items.caption: A fun moment under the bright blue sky — meeting and taking photos with international hikers at the top.
items.alt: Taking photos with international hikers at the summit of Mount Andong under a clear blue sky with thin clouds

items.caption: The green ridge trail of Mount Andong glowing under the morning sun from a clean, clear sky.
items.alt: View of the green ridge trail of Mount Andong under bright sunlight and a clear blue sky

items.judul: Ice Cream Under the Red and White
items.caption: Celebrating the cool summit wind with ice cream together under the waving Red and White flag and the grandeur of Mount Merbabu.
items.alt: Posing together holding ice cream cones under the Red and White flagpole with Mount Merbabu in the background

items.judul: Ice Cream Queue at the Summit
items.caption: Willingly waiting in a long line on the sun-drenched mountain ridge for the legendary summit ice cream.
items.alt: Hikers queuing on the ridge of Mount Andong waiting for their turn to buy summit ice cream

items.caption: The pink jacket already neatly tied to the backpack as the sun warmed up, then turning around to give the cheeriest double peace pose.
items.alt: Funny video of a pink jacket tied to a backpack then turning around smiling with a two-finger peace pose

items.caption: From an adorable finger heart to watching the vendor directly assemble a three-flavor ice cream cone high up at the peak.
items.alt: Video of buying a three-flavor ice cream cone directly at the summit of Mount Andong

items.caption: Extra slot ready for the next clear sky photo collection.
items.alt: Placeholder for the seventh clear sky memory photo

items.caption: Extra slot ready for the next clear sky photo collection.
items.alt: Placeholder for the eighth clear sky memory photo

narasi: A clear view in every direction.
I thought there would be clouds below us.
At least we get a good view of Merbabu.

kutipan: The day began in colors no camera could get right.

items.caption: Looking warmly at the morning sun slowly rising through the thin mist on the eastern horizon.
items.alt: Looking at the golden sunrise from the height of Mount Andong above a misty valley

items.caption: While the sky was still dark blue before dawn, the village lights at the foot of Mount Merbabu looked like scattered stars.
items.alt: View of dark blue dawn with the silhouette of Mount Merbabu and the glittering lights of settlements in the valley below

items.judul: Dawn Clip: Valley Lights & Orange Glow
items.caption: Warm laughter in the cold early morning, as the village lights in the valley blended with the first orange glow behind Merbabu and Merapi.
items.alt: Video of blue dawn at Mount Andong with valley lights and the silhouettes of Mount Merbabu and Merapi

kutipan: A good hike, and good company. Until the next one.

items.caption: One sweet memory photo at the summit before heading down together.
items.alt: Closing memory photo of two people at Sunrise Camp on Mount Andong
